sources.label: Theo thGOLD documentation (deployed contract and controls)
Theo thBILL blacklistability precedent (pausable institutional design)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: thGOLD is deployed on Ethereum at 0x610F0E33b0A6b3802ff29D3Cf6bBd9A0ACF784ed (MetalToken, 6 decimals, created 2026-09-15, verified ERC-1967 proxy, listed on Theo's addresses page). Theo documents no pause, blacklist, transfer fee or transfer hook, so holders transfer freely; the verdict stays possible because the Timelock can upgrade the implementation. Mint is gated to the 4-of-6 Operator Safe.
